---
name: Report a bug
about: Something in Spoken Margins did not work the way you expected
labels: needs-triage-review
---

**What happened.** In a sentence or two, what you saw.

**What you expected.** What you thought would happen instead.

**Steps.** What you did, in order, starting from where you were in the app.
1.
2.

**Which build.** Settings has a Version line with the version and build number. Say whether it came from TestFlight or you built it yourself.

**Your device.** For example, iPhone 16 Pro on iOS 26.

**Anything else.** A screenshot helps. Please leave out private text from your Library, and say if the problem only happens with one article, PDF or podcast (a link is enough).
